_comment: Release verification template. Fill in the 'release' section with actual Jira issues for each release.
_usage: Copy this file, rename it (e.g. release-12.28.5.json), fill in release_issues, then run: python main.py --config configs/release-12.28.5.json
_mode_comment: Tells the agent this is a targeted release check, not a full scan. Focus on changed files only.

release._release_notes_url_comment: URL to the Jira release page. Example: https://your-domain.atlassian.net/projects/EXAMPLE/versions/xxxxx

issues.title: {{ISSUE_TITLE}}
issues._comment: Copy this block for each Jira issue in the release. Fill ALL fields.

issues._example: This is a filled example — delete before use
issues.title: Proposal Checklists: Admin > Workflows — error saving
issues.what_to_verify: Open Admin > Workflows. Select any workflow. Change any checkbox value and click Save Workflow Configuration. Must save successfully with NO error.

issues._example: Second filled example — delete before use
issues.title: Proposal Checklist Does Not Load For Child Locations
issues.what_to_verify: Create a work request using a CHILD location. Verify the Proposal Checklist loads correctly.

release._issues_comment: List every Jira issue included in this release. The agent will focus test generation on the changed files.

_priority_filter_comment: Release verification focuses on critical and high priority only.
_dry_run_comment: Always start with dry_run=true. Switch to false only after reviewing output.
_output_file_comment: Where to save generated test cases.
_push_to_xray_comment: Set to true to push directly to Xray.
_jira_labels_comment: Labels for release verification test cases in Jira.
_test_environment_comment: The environment where these tests must be executed.
notes: Always run EXAMPLE-2588 (Business Critical) first — block release if it fails
EXAMPLE-2603 requires test data: checklist assigned to PARENT location + work request at CHILD location
EXAMPLE-2583 requires Pre-check questionnaire configured with at least 1 action
_notes_comment: Free-text notes visible in the run report. Add anything the tester needs to know.
